summary: XPeng Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing proposed amendments to its memorandum and articles of association to conform with Hong Kong Listing Rules' core shareholder protection standards and corporate governance code, including virtual meeting provisions and nomination committee terms. This is a routine governance update requiring shareholder approval at the AGM via special resolution. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation event is involved; the filing is a standard foreign private issuer report for corporate housekeeping.
